Application Description

A little scene. A much bigger surprise. Discover wallpapers that turn a close-up into a whole new story when you explore the full picture. Duopaper pairs a focused folded preview with a panoramic expanded view of the same artwork. A tiny character can belong to an unexpected world; a quiet detail can be part of something wonderfully strange. Find a scene that feels right for your foldable or wide screen, then see what it has been hiding. Make room for your style. entry.title: To the Moon
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$4.99 → $1.99 [$1.99 ~ $4.99]）

All Price Information

Price：$1.99

Application Description

A story-driven experience about two doctors traversing backwards through a dying man's memories to artificially fulfill his last wish. ABOUT THIS GAME Dr. Rosalene and Dr. Watts have peculiar jobs: They give people another chance to live, all the way from the very beginning... but only in their patients' heads. Due to the severity of the operation, the new life becomes the last thing the patients remember before drawing their last breath. Thus, the operation is only done to people on their deathbeds, to fulfill what they wish they had done with their lives, but didn’t. This particular story follows their attempt to fulfill the dream of an elderly man, Johnny. With each step back in time, a new fragment of Johnny's past is revealed. As the two doctors piece together the puzzled events that spanned a life time, they seek to find out just why the frail old man chose his dying wish to be what it is. And Johnny's last wish is, of course... to go to the moon. MORE DETAILS "To the Moon", a story-driven RPG with pixel graphics, was originally developed six years ago for PC by Canadian producer Kan Gao and Freebird Games, his indie game studio.Rights to develop and publish the remastered mobile version of "To the Moon" were acquired by X.D. Network Inc. The story of "To the Moon" unfolds before players, much like a movie. While the entire game has no battle system and can be completed in a few hours, the compelling story and moving original soundtrack resonated with players worldwide. On top of receiving overwhelmingly positive ratings, "To the Moon" received multiple awards from Gamespot, Metacritic, WIRED, and more, and was nominated for "I'm Not Crying, There's Something In My Eye" in the 2016 Steam Awards. KEY FEATURES • Unlocked 29 new iMessage stickers. • Added "Music Box" function, allowing backstage music playing& in-game music downloading(will be enabled automatically after clearing the stage). • Added "DIY QR code" function, allowing one-key sharing of player data for playing on different devices. • A unique & non-combat story-driven experience • Innovative mix between adventure game elements and classic RPG aesthetics • Acclaimed original soundtrack that closely ties to the story • An espresso execution with zero filler and no time drains Languages Supported: * English * Français * Deutsch * Español (Latinoamérica) * Español (Europa) * Português * Polski * lingua italiana (Italian) * Người việt nam * русский(Russian) * 한국어 (Korean) * 简体中文 (Simplified Chinese) * 繁體中文 (Traditional Chinese) * 日本語 (Japanese) * Türk dili(Turkish) * Українська（Ukraine） Facebook: /TotheMoonHD Twitter: @TotheMoonHD Service email: TotheMoon@xindong.com © 2017 X.D. entry.title: Solar Arc: Golden Hour Tracker
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$4.99 → $3.99 [Free ~ $5.99]）

All Price Information

Price：$3.99

Application Description

Golden hour happens every single day. Most people miss it. SolarArc makes sure you don't. - Chasing golden hour for a photo? Know the exact minute it starts. - Planning a sunrise hike? See the best trail windows at a glance. - Wondering when the moon rises tonight? It's right there on your screen. SolarArc is a sun and moon tracker that feels like looking out the window. Every view shifts with the real sky - warm when the light is warm, dark when the sky is dark. THE GRADIENT LINE Your entire day, painted in one line. Dawn amber bleeds into midday blue, then sunset orange, then deep navy night. Golden hour glows. Blue hour cools. You can read the exact times, or just glance at the color and know where you are in the day. THE ARC The sun and moon traced across your sky in real time. Watch them rise, climb, and fall against a live gradient that shifts with the actual light outside your window. Drag your finger across the arc to scrub through the day - the sky, the times, and the numbers all move with you. View the sun alone, the moon alone, or both together. THE MOON Know when to look up. SolarArc renders tonight's moon with the correct phase shape on the arc. Plan around full moons. Catch a crescent at dusk. Know exactly how dark the sky will be. 52-WEEK FORECAST What will golden hour look like three Saturdays from now? How much daylight will you have on that hiking trip in April? Pick any date in the next year and see the full picture - sun, moon, and light - before you commit. FIVE WAYS TO USE THE SKY Photography - Golden hour and blue hour, down to the minute. Stop guessing when to shoot. Hiking - Best trail windows and how much daylight is left. Know when to turn around. Screens - A screen curfew that follows the sun. Wind down as the sky does. Gardening - When to water, when to protect, and how many sun hours your plants get today. Stargazing - When true darkness begins. The best window to see everything above you. FEATURES - Live gradient line and arc visualizations - Drag to scrub through any moment of the day - Sun view, moon view, or dual view - Golden hour and blue hour timing - Moonrise, moonset, phase, and illumination - 52-week forecast for any date - Five activity modes - Seven Home Screen widgets: sun and moon, line and arc, medium and large - Notifications for sunrise, sunset, and golden hour - Multi-location with automatic timezone handling - Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Ukrainian, and Russian - Built on NOAA solar and Meeus lunar algorithms - Fully offline. No tracking. No account required. WHAT IS GOLDEN HOUR? Golden hour is the short window after sunrise and before sunset when the light turns soft, warm, and directional. Photographers chase it. Hikers love it. SolarArc tells you exactly when it happens, wherever you are. EVERYTHING INCLUDED All seven widgets, the 52-week forecast, unlimited saved places, all five modes, and golden hour, sunrise, and sunset alerts. One purchase. No subscription. No ads. No in-app purchases. Made by Spruzzo Labs - a creative lab. Questions or ideas? hello@spruzzolabs.com

Bring your virtual pets along on iPhone and iPad. Import compatible firmware, care for your pets, and keep each device's progress in your cabinet. Firmware-specific guidance requires supported imported firmware. • An album of your time together Record characters you encounter and raise, collected pieces, achievements, and growth milestones. Make a postcard from a character's page or create a group card. Choose a background, share the result, or save it as an image or Live Photo. Artwork for compatible games is read from your imported firmware; Pocochi uses original artwork. • One cabinet, independent devices Create up to 20 pet devices, each with its own progress and appearance. With two devices, rotate one for face-to-face play. • Play with friends nearby Choose multiplayer inside a compatible game and the app connects automatically. Lend or return a device face to face: the lender's copy stays locked until it returns with the latest progress. With permission, local notifications can report events during background updates. iOS schedules background work, so updates and notifications may be delayed; continuous operation and fixed notification times are not guaranteed. • Make yourself at home Choose a minimal or detailed 3D shell, different colors, a full-device view or a larger screen, and an optional LCD filter. Add screen widgets in several sizes or a separate button widget. The interface follows your system's light or dark appearance. • Keep your progress Progress saves automatically. Optional iCloud backup and whole-app restore include your cabinet, games, and player profile. You can also back up individual devices to a folder you choose. If something goes wrong, export a diagnostic report, choose whether to attach one device's save, and decide where to save or send it. Reports are never uploaded automatically. Interactive lessons help you get started and learn individual features. You can exit and revisit them whenever you like. Commercial game firmware is not included.
